QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Essentials
QuestInfo.0: Shulla's clearing up the remains of a collapsed roof. You should see if she needs any help.
QuestInfo.1: Shulla's determined to collect what food she can from the debris, since you'll need it for the trip to the next town. Unfortunately, she's having trouble finding anything salvageable. You should see if you can help her.
QuestInfo.2: You tried to help Shulla find some food for the trip in the debris, but everything's been burnt to a crisp. Tell Peytour.
